title: Unity CLI Context Descriptor
description: Describes a read-only context exposed by the Unity CLI. Contexts provide observation without mutation; if a capability modifies Unity state it must be a Tool, not a Context.

name.description: Dotted context identifier, e.g. 'project.info'. Must be unique across all contexts.

summary.description: Short routing summary used by context list/describe so an AI can select the right context during discovery.

description.description: One-paragraph explanation of what the context reads and its read-only boundary.

source.description: Origin: built-in, project custom context, or extension.

target.description: Execution target: editor, runtime, or both.

availabilityScope.description: Availability scope for reading this context.

playModeSupport.description: Play Mode read semantics for this context.

available.description: Whether the context is currently available based on Unity state. Populated by live discovery responses.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for context read input parameters. TS contexts provide this through defineContext; C# contexts derive it from the Request DTO.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema for context read output. TS contexts provide this through defineContext; C# contexts derive it from the Result DTO.

cliCommand.description: CLI command to read this context, e.g. 'context read project.info'.

supportStatus.description: Current routing status for AI execution decisions.

requiresPackages.description: Unity package names required by this context at runtime.

extensionId.description: Extension ID when this context is contributed by an extension.

dependencies.description: Names of other contexts this context depends on.

refreshBehavior.description: Read cost and staleness behavior, such as static, onDemand, or live.
